verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a testing and observability SaaS platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core platform. The public GitHub repo is only a skills/MCP plugin for AI coding assistants, and the CLI, SDK and API all reach Cekura's hosted service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
